verdicts.reason: A broke the bottle-in-cream-circle badge apart: the stray cream circle now sits under the 'B/S' of the headline, which is an unwanted collision. Its buttons also lost their pill shape and are square-cornered and misaligned (NEW is centred, Try It is offset right), and the bottle floats small in the top-left. B keeps the bottle badge and the pill buttons intact, and the headline is left-aligned and readable. However, everything in B is crammed into the top 60% with a dead empty bottom 40%, the buttons are right-aligned against a left-aligned headline, and the decorative circle is clipped at the top-left corner.
